docs/orchestrating-elastic-stack-applications/elasticsearch/orchestration.asciidoc:119:* Elasticsearch `Pods` may stay `Pending` during a rolling upgrade if the Kubernetes scheduler cannot re-schedule them back. Implemented the Kubernetes 0.18 client API migration and related fake-client/resource-version fixes.

Key changes:
- Updated native client-go calls to pass `context` and `CreateOptions`/`UpdateOptions`/`ListOptions`.
- Updated REST request usage from old `.Context(...).Stream()` / `.Do()` forms.
- Preserved `resourceVersion`/`UID` during generic reconciler updates to avoid fake-client conflicts.
- Refreshed pods before annotation updates.
- Changed licensing ConfigMap save logic from unconditional update to get-or-create/update.
- Added compatibility in `WrappedFakeClient` for legacy empty-name fake fixtures.
- Fixed Go 1.19 vet failures in `hack/pipeline-validator`.

Verification:
- Passing: `/usr/local/go/bin/go test $(/usr/local/go/bin/go list ./... | grep -v '^github.com/elastic/cloud-on-k8s/pkg/controller/webhook$' | grep -v '^github.com/elastic/cloud-on-k8s/test/e2e')`
- Full `go test ./...` still cannot fully pass locally because:
  - `pkg/controller/webhook/reconcile_test.go` directly calls old client-go method signatures, and I did not modify test files per your constraint.
  - e2e packages require a Kubernetes config/cluster in this environment.
